_comment: Speeds keep a 30:20:18:35 ratio, scaled so a Model 1 sails Rome-Tunis (326.6 nm) in about 60 s. range_nm is the longest single leg the model can sail (Model 1: 1 min 30 s of sailing, Model 2: 3 min 30 s, Model 3: 6 min, Model 4: any Med port to the US East Coast). max_owned is how many of each model the player can own. map_size (length, width in pixels) and map_color are how the ship is drawn on the map.
